issues.description: API key hardcoded in source code. This is a major security vulnerability.
issues.suggestion: Move to environment variables: const apiKey = process.env.STRIPE_API_KEY

issues.description: Missing input validation for subscription plan ID
issues.suggestion: Validate planId against whitelist of allowed plans before processing

issues.description: Missing error handling for Stripe API calls. Errors not logged or propagated.
issues.suggestion: Add try-catch with proper error logging and user-friendly error messages

issues.description: No rate limiting on subscription verification endpoint
issues.suggestion: Implement rate limiting to prevent brute force attacks
Create enum or constants: const SUBSCRIPTION_STATUS = { ACTIVE: 'active', ... }

issues.description: Missing logging for subscription state changes (audit trail)
issues.suggestion: Log all subscription modifications for compliance and debugging

codeQuality.summary: Critical security vulnerabilities present. API key exposure, input validation issues, and missing error handling require immediate attention before this can be merged.

untestedPaths.reasoning: No tests for subscription creation - critical business logic

untestedPaths.location: API error handling (network timeout, invalid response)

testCoverage.summary: CRITICAL: No test coverage for subscription service. All functionality untested, including error scenarios and edge cases.

suggestions.description: Create Subscription domain model and use dependency injection for Stripe client
suggestions.benefits: Testable via mocking, decoupled from Stripe implementation, easier to swap providers

suggestions.description: Extract validation logic into SubscriptionValidator class
suggestions.before: if (!validPlans.includes(planId)) throw Error(...); if (!userId) throw Error(...)
suggestions.after: class SubscriptionValidator { validatePlanId(id: string): void { ... } validateUserId(id: string): void { ... } }
suggestions.benefits: Single responsibility, reusable validation, better error messages

suggestions.description: Extract Stripe API communication into separate StripeAdapter
suggestions.before: const result = await stripe.subscriptions.create({...}); if (!result) throw Error(...)
suggestions.after: const adapter = new StripeAdapter(); const result = await adapter.createSubscription(...)
suggestions.benefits: Cleaner separation of concerns, easier to test, single point for Stripe changes

refactorings.summary: Major refactoring needed: implement dependency injection, extract validation/adapter patterns, and add domain models.

issues.description: Component directly calls API endpoints instead of using service layer
issues.suggestion: Use subscriptionService from src/services instead of direct API calls

issues.description: Sensitive payment info passed through component state
issues.suggestion: Use secure storage (HTTP-only cookies) for sensitive data, never in React state

issues.description: Missing loading state during async operations
issues.suggestion: Add loading state: setIsProcessing(true) during subscription creation

issues.description: Component is 300+ lines. Consider breaking into smaller sub-components
issues.suggestion: Extract PricingTable, SubscriptionForm into separate components

codeQuality.summary: Component architecture issues with architectural anti-patterns. Needs refactoring to follow best practices.

untestedPaths.reasoning: No test validates component renders correctly
No test for subscription initiation flow
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: const user = userEvent.setup(); await user.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /subscribe/i })); expect(mockSubscribe).toHaveBeenCalled()

untestedPaths.reasoning: No test validates error display to user

testCoverage.summary: No test coverage for critical payment UI component. User flows completely untested.

suggestions.description: Break 300+ line component into smaller components
suggestions.benefits: Improved testability, better component reusability, easier to maintain

suggestions.description: Use custom hook for subscription state management
suggestions.before: const [subscription, setSubscription] = useState(...); const [loading, setLoading] = useState(...)
suggestions.after: const { subscription, loading, error, createSubscription } = useSubscription();
suggestions.benefits: Reusable logic, cleaner component, easier testing of hook separately

refactorings.summary: Component needs significant refactoring: break into smaller components, use custom hooks, follow service layer pattern.

issues.description: Timestamps not using database-native timestamp types
issues.suggestion: Use TIMESTAMP type with DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP and ON UPDATE

issues.description: Missing foreign key constraint to users table
issues.suggestion: Add: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

issues.description: Missing indexes on frequently queried columns
issues.suggestion: Add indexes: CREATE INDEX idx_subscription_user_id ON subscriptions(user_id); CREATE INDEX idx_subscription_status ON subscriptions(status)

codeQuality.summary: Database schema is functional but missing important database-level constraints and optimizations.

untestedPaths.reasoning: No test validates schema is created correctly
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: await runMigration(); const schema = await db.query('DESCRIBE subscriptions'); expect(schema).toContainColumn('status')

testCoverage.summary: Schema file not tested. Database migrations and constraints should be validated.

suggestions.description: Create migration file separate from schema definition
suggestions.benefits: Better version control, easier to track schema evolution, standard migration pattern

refactorings.summary: Minor refactoring recommended to follow database migration best practices.

recommendations.description: BLOCKING: Remove hardcoded API key and move to environment variables immediately. This is a major security vulnerability.
Add input validation for all user inputs before processing subscriptions (planId, userId, payment details)
Add comprehensive test coverage for subscription service (currently 0%). Include error scenarios and edge cases.
Add test coverage for PremiumFeatures component and user payment flows
Implement comprehensive error handling for Stripe API calls with proper logging
Implement dependency injection pattern for Stripe client to improve testability
Add indexes on frequently queried columns (user_id, status) for better query performance
Break down PremiumFeatures component into smaller sub-components for better maintainability
